title: District Commission may direct parties to consider mediation
description: District Commission may direct parties to consider mediation

content.what: may direct parties to give in writing consent to have their dispute settled by mediation
conditions: at the first hearing of the complaint after its admission, or at any later stage
if it appears that there exists elements of a settlement which may be acceptable to the parties
except in such cases as may be prescribed
